title: A Kiss at Midnight
description: A professional matchmaker (Faith Ford) and a widower (Cameron Daddo) meet through an Internet dating service.

title: Fixing Pete
description: Sparks fly when Ashley (Brooke Burns) is asked to do a TV makeover for an obnoxious and sexist sports writer (Dylan Bruno).

title: The Reading Room
description: Street thugs jeopardize a widower's (James Earl Jones) mission to teach low-income people in his community how to read.

title: Rescuing Madison
description: Sparks fly between a singer (Alona Tal) and the handsome firefighter (Ethan Peck) who saved her life.

title: Horton Foote's: Alone
description: John Webb (Hume Cronyn) is recently widowed and living alone on the farm he and his brother used to share. He rarely sees his daughters, Jacqueline (Joanna Miles) and Grace Ann (Roxanne Hart), and his only company is Grey (James Earl Jones), the farm's longtime overseer. John's solitude is interrupted by his nephews, Carl (Frederic Forrest) and Gus Jr. (Chris Cooper), who have been approached about drilling for oil on the farm. Tensions rise as John clashes with his opportunistic family.

title: The Wishing Well
description: A reporter (Jordan Ladd) for a major network thinks a small town's wishing well is a joke until her wish is granted.

title: Where There's a Will
description: On the run from a loan shark, a con man (Frank Whaley) has a change of heart while staying with his grandmother (Marion Ross) in Texas.

title: Bound & Babysitting
description: Forced to baby-sit with her college nemesis (Travis Van Winkle), a young woman (Tammin Sursok) starts to see the man in a new light.

title: How Not to Propose
description: Things go awry when a man (Ryan Merriman) plans a romantic getaway to propose to his longtime girlfriend (Kayla Ewell).

title: Expecting a Miracle
description: Already facing difficult issues, a married couple (Jason Priestley, Teri Polo) find solace in a Mexican town when their car breaks down.

title: Just Desserts
description: With his family's Bronx bakery skating toward bankruptcy, baker Marco Poloni tries to prevent his Uncle Fab from selling the property. Marco teams up with the restaurant's pastry chef, Grace Carpenter, to enter a dessert competition with a $250,000 grand prize, hoping to split the earnings to save his bakery and give her money for her own restaurant. Initially at odds, the professional partners soon begin to develop feelings for each other.

title: Uncorked
description: A businesswoman (Julie Benz) meets a famous chef (Scott Elrod) and his family (JoBeth Williams, Elliott Gould) while visiting California's wine country.

title: Diagnosis Delicious
description: A young doctor (Maya Stojan) finds an effective cure for her stress when she attends a cooking class.

title: Mary, Mother of Jesus
description: This Biblical story of Jesus Christ is told through the eyes of the Virgin Mary (Pernilla August). Raised in Nazareth, Mary is betrothed to Joseph (David Threlfall) when the angel Gabriel appears to her, announcing that she is chosen to give birth to the messianic son of God, who will be conceived by the Holy Spirit. During a journey to Bethlehem for a Roman census, Mary gives birth to Jesus (Christian Bale), and later is witness to her son's miracles, as well as his persecution and crucifixion.

title: Letter Never Sent
description: A man (Callard Harris) learns that the high-school love letter he wrote to his best friend (Haley Webb) is now in the hands of her new boyfriend.

title: Love Takes Wing
description: A widowed doctor (Sarah Jones) tries to help residents of a frontier town where a mysterious illness claims several lives.

title: After the Fall
description: Jenna Danville, a competitive show jumper, becomes temporarily paralyzed after a fall from a horse. With an indomitable spirit, she fights to walk and ride again with help from friends and family.

title: Legally Tender
description: After inheriting a house, a lawyer (Emily Rose) finds herself in a legal battle with a historian (Justin Bruening) who tells her it was the site of the first Thanksgiving.

title: The Mechanics of Love
description: A tech entrepreneur is shocked to learn that her father's auto repair shop is in the red. She soon learns that a charming childhood friend wants to buy the struggling business.

title: Wild Hearts
description: A recently widowed detective moves from Los Angeles to his family's mustang farm to care for his grieving daughter.
